Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

- Command to set the volume 

| Head  |Len   |Cmd   |Vol   |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes)   |0x8   |xx (0~15)   |xx   |0x02   |

Vol: 0 to 15 (representing the volume level).
